account: Chinese rules of July 2023 require generative AI services to uphold the Core Socialist Values. In October 2024, Freedom House described these rules as subjecting generative AI providers to the censorship regulations of the Cyberspace Administration of China. China Telecom uses a distilled and instruction-tuned model that screens generated material against its political and ideological criteria. China Telecom states that the platform runs across its network and covers 622 million users. It reports false-positive and false-negative rates of approximately 6%. Whether this screening improves public welfare remains unresolved.

ai_role.statement: A learned language model identifies policy-sensitive expressions beyond simple keyword matching.
